paper.title: Continuum-Armed Bandits: A Function Space Perspective

settings.name_in_paper: Noiseless continuum-armed bandits over Besov ball B^sigma_{p,q}([0,1]^d, L)
unmapped: Objective function lies in a Besov ball B^sigma_{p,q}(X, L) on X=[0,1]^d (wavelet-defined Besov norm), sigma > d/p; includes Hölder (p=q=inf) and Sobolev (p=q=2) as special cases
Both simple regret and cumulative regret are studied (zeroth-order maximisation of f)
settings.definition_quote: Fix an unknown function $f \in \B_{p,q}^\sigma(\X, L)$... In the noiseless case, the goal is to minimize either the expected simple regret $R_S(\hat X, f) := \E_Z [ \sup_{x} f(x) - f(X_T)]$ or the expected cumulative regret $R_C(\hat X, f) := \E_Z [ \sum_{n = 1}^T \sup_{x} f(x) - f(X_n)]$.

settings.name_in_paper: Noisy continuum-armed bandits over Besov ball with sub-Gaussian noise subG(eta^2)
unmapped: Objective function lies in a Besov ball B^sigma_{p,q}(X, L) on X=[0,1]^d, sigma > d/p
Both simple regret and cumulative regret are studied
settings.definition_quote: In the noisy case, we additionally fix a noise probability distribution $P$... $Y_t = f(X_t) + \epsilon_t$, where $\epsilon_1,...,\epsilon_T \IID P$... we shall consider the case when $\P = \subG$ is the class of sub-Gaussian random variables with variance proxy $\eta^2$.

source.label: thm:noisy_rates
source.quote: For $\sigma > d/p$, $M_{S,T}(\B_{p,q}^\sigma(\X, L), \subG) \asymp M_{S,T}(\C^{\sigma - d/p}(\X, L), \subG) \asymp \max \{ ( \frac{\eta^2 \log \frac{T}{\eta^2}}{T} )^{\frac{\sigma - d/p}{2(\sigma - d/p) + d}}, M_{S,T}(\B_{p,q}^\sigma(\X, L)) \}$

results.notes: eta mapped to sigma (sub-Gaussian parameter). The second term in the max is the noiseless minimax rate T^{1/p - sigma/d} from Theorem 4. Fano-based proof.

bound.expression: Max((sigma**2*log(T/sigma**2)/T)**((s_b - d/p_b)/(2*(s_b - d/p_b) + d)), T**(1/p_b - s_b/d))

conditions: f in Besov ball B^sigma_{p,q}([0,1]^d, L)
sigma > d/p

source.label: thm:noisy_rates
source.quote:
For $\sigma > d/p$,
    \begin{align*}
        & M_{S,T} \left( \B_{p,q}^\sigma(\X, L), \subG \right) \\
        & \asymp M_{S,T} \left( \C^{\sigma - d/p}(\X, L), \subG \right) \\
        & \asymp \max \left\{ \left( \frac{\eta^2 \log \frac{T}{\eta^2}}{T} \right)^{\frac{\sigma - d/p}{2(\sigma - d/p) + d}}\hspace{-2mm},
          M_{S,T} \left( \B_{p,q}^\sigma(\X, L) \right) \right\},
    \end{align*}

results.notes: Upper half of the Theta claim, derived from the cumulative-regret upper bound of Auer et al. (2007) for s in (0,1] via embedding and Remark 6; justification for sigma - d/p > 1 not given in the proof.

bound.expression_latex: \max \{ T^{\frac{d + \sigma - d/p}{2(\sigma - d/p) + d}} ( \eta^2 \log \frac{T}{\eta^2} )^{\frac{\sigma - d/p}{2(\sigma - d/p) + d}}, M_{C,T}(\B_{p,q}^\sigma(\X, L)) \}

results.notes: Cumulative regret defined through f values -> pseudo_regret. Second max term is the noiseless cumulative rate T^{1+1/p-sigma/d}. Text says the lower bound also holds for sigma > d/p+1.
